metadata.dataset: Star of the North selection line: the official NCTA line chained west-to-east from the MN-84 crossing north of Longville to the MN-6 crossing northeast of Remer
metadata.source: NCTA 'North Country Trail (Public)' ArcGIS feature service, Minnesota portion (data/segments/official-line-minnesota.geojson, pulled Nov 13, 2026 by scripts/pull_minnesota_line.py)
metadata.extent_definition: NCTA Star of the North Chapter page (northcountrytrail.org/trail/minnesota/stn/): 'from Minnesota 84 to Highway 6, northeast of Remer'; ~30 miles of trail (chapter spring-cleanup notice). The service's `chapter` attribute is NOT used: it tags only 10.2 mi as STN and the rest of this same trail as ARW.
metadata.method: 12 official-line features chained end-to-end (endpoint match within 0.15 km, no breaks); west end clipped at lon -94.21 (MN-84 crossing, 3.87 mi cut off the STN footpath); east end is the chain end where the footpath meets the Highway 6 road walk (-93.847, 47.103). Counties: Cass only (MnGeo county boundaries service, Nov 18, 2026). On-road connectors (3 features, 0.74 mi) are kept in this file but excluded from parcel selection.
metadata.judgment: J1: MN-84 crossing placed at lon -94.21 from the OSM road line's northern terminus (-94.209, 46.981) and Longville (-94.207); good to ~0.3 mi. The 3.87 mi of footpath west of the cut is Itasca Moraine territory per the chapter definition and is already covered by the chapter parcels (3 parcels within 3 m, verified Nov 18, 2026), so the cut loses nothing and draws no parcel twice. Note the chapter's '30 miles of trail' counts the full 30.59-mi chain from the Itasca Moraine boundary; the clipped STN line is 26.67 mi.
